description: Before WORK (a `git commit`, or a build/test command), checks that the mandatory skills were invoked this session — a fresh per-skill marker in ~/.cache/agent-tools/skills-invoked/. MANDATORY_SKILLS (default delegate-work-to-subagents,visual-proof-cycle), freshness SKILLS_FRESH_WINDOW_S (7200s). WARN first, BLOCK on repeat (default WARN-first so it never wedges while the marker-writer is wired). A dispatched subagent (agent_id present) is exempt from the two orchestration/visual defaults (it IS the delegate; non-UI work has no visual proof) but still gated on any project-specific MANDATORY_SKILLS entry. Escape hatch: ALLOW_SKIP_SKILLS=1 + ALLOW_SKIP_SKILLS_REASON='why', or inline `# skills-ok: why`. on_error=open.
